entities.summary: Dwayne Jarrett is an American former professional football player who was a wide receiver for four seasons with the Carolina Panthers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the USC Trojans, earning recognition as an All-American twice. Carolina selected him in the second round of the 2007 NFL Draft.
